June 19, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Falcon Point Capital Llc increased its stake in Central Garden And Pet Co (CENTA) by 3.72% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Falcon Point Capital Llc bought 10,347 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.31% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 288,197 shares of the consumer specialties company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $11.42 million, up from 277,850 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Falcon Point Capital Llc who had been investing in Central Garden And Pet Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.18B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.07% or $0.03 during the last trading session, reaching $41.27. About 111,820 shares traded. Central Garden & Pet Company (NASDAQ:CENTA) has risen 31.34% since June 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 18.77% the S&P500. The institutional investor held 1,345 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.95M, up from 826 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
